steps.title: Dispense water to destination
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel P20 pipette, dispense the custom volume of water listed for each well in the CSV file into the corresponding wells of the destination plate.

steps.title: Add RNA (direct or diluted)
steps.instruction: For each well, dispense the custom RNA volume from the CSV file with a single‑channel P20. If the listed RNA volume is less than 2 µL, first create a 5× dilution (3 µL RNA + 12 µL water) in a temporary plate, mix, then transfer a volume equal to five times the intended RNA volume to the destination well while reducing the water volume accordingly. Mix the destination well after each RNA dispense.

substeps.instruction: If RNA volume ≥ 2 µL, dispense the RNA directly into the destination well.
If RNA volume < 2 µL, prepare a 5× dilution by adding 3 µL RNA and 12 µL water to a temporary plate and mixing.
Transfer a volume equal to 5 × the intended RNA volume from the dilution to the destination well, adjusting the water volume to keep total volume constant, then mix.
